The '''Rebel Forward Base Camp''' was a small staging ground for the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] near the contested [[Weapons Depot]] on the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:C2" />

==Behind the scenes==
This Rebel Forward Base Camp is a location in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It serves as a spawning point for Rebel players near the Weapons Depot, which is a zone where [[Wikipedia:Player versus player|PVP]]-enabled (Special Forces) players fight for the control over the depot. Players that died in battle can clone here and re-join the fight. It can be reached by [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] from every shuttleport and starport on Talus. The camp was added with the [[:w:c:swg:Chapter 2|Chapter 2]] update in August [[2006]] that changed the Weapons Depot into a PVP zone.<ref name="SWG:C2" />
